title: GBOGBO agbaiye e wa gb'oro Jesu

lines.text: GBOGBO agbaiye e wa gb'oro Jesu
lines.marked: Gbogbo agbaiye ẹ̀ wá gb'ọ̀rọ̀ Jésù

lines.text: On ni Oluwa t'o le gba 'raiye
lines.marked: On ni Olúwa t'ó lè gbà 'raiye

lines.text: Omo Ogun Kristi, e tun ona Re se
lines.marked: Ọmọ Ogun Kristi, ẹ tún ọ̀nà Rẹ̀ ṣe

lines.text: Jesu Oluwa mbo wa, joba l'aiye.
lines.marked: Jésù Olúwa ḿbọ́ wa, jọba l'aiye.
